_comment: SEISMIC_SURGE_TOKEN_CONTROLLED_THIS_TURN was set by nothing, so this could never fire. 'Controlled this turn' is deliberately broader than 'created this turn' -- a token stolen, given, or simply still there from last turn was never created -- so it reads the 'controlled' turn event, which Zone.add records on arena entry and start_of_turn_refresh_player sweeps for permanents that were already there.
